Awesome OpenClaw Skills  超棒的 OpenClaw 技巧

OpenClaw is a locally-running AI assistant that operates directly on your machine. Skills extend its capabilities, allowing it to interact with external services, automate workflows, and perform specialized tasks. This collection helps you discover and install the right skills for your needs. It can also serve as a source of inspiration for OpenClaw use cases.
OpenClaw 是一款本地运行的 AI 助手，直接在您的计算机上运行。技能可以扩展其功能，使其能够与外部服务交互、自动化工作流程并执行特定任务。此合集可帮助您发现并安装满足您需求的合适技能。它还可以为 OpenClaw 的应用案例提供灵感。

Skills in this list are sourced from ClawHub (OpenClaw's public skills registry) and categorized for easier discovery.
此列表中的技能来源于 ClawHub（OpenClaw 的公共技能注册表），并进行了分类以便于查找。

Installation  安装

ClawHub CLI

clawhub install <skill-slug>

Manual Installation  手动安装

Copy the skill folder to one of these locations:
将技能文件夹复制到以下位置之一：

Location  地点 Path  小路
Global  全球的 ~/.openclaw/skills/
Workspace  工作区 <project>/skills/

Priority: Workspace > Local > Bundled
优先级：工作区 > 本地 > 捆绑

Alternative  选择

You can also paste the skill's GitHub repository link directly into your assistant's chat and ask it to use it. The assistant will handle the setup automatically in the background.
您也可以直接将技能的 GitHub 代码库链接粘贴到助手的聊天窗口中，并让它使用该技能。助手会在后台自动完成设置。

Why This List Exists?  这份清单存在的意义是什么？

OpenClaw's public registry (ClawHub) hosts 13,729 community-built skills as of February 28, 2026. This awesome list has 5,494 skills. Here's what we filtered out:
截至 2026 年 2 月 28 日，OpenClaw 的公共注册中心 (ClawHub) 收录了 13,729 项社区创建的技能。 这份精选列表包含 5,494 项技能 。以下是我们筛选出的内容：

Filter  筛选 Excluded  已排除

可能是垃圾邮件——批量账户、机器人账户、测试/垃圾账户		 4,065
Duplicate / Similar name
重复/相似名称		 1,040

低质量或非英文描述		 851
Crypto / Blockchain / Finance / Trade
加密货币/区块链/金融/贸易		 611
Malicious — identified by security audits published by researchers (excluding VirusTotal)
恶意——由研究人员发布的安全审计报告（不包括 VirusTotal）识别。		 373
Total not taken from OpenClaw's official skill registry
总数并非取自 OpenClaw 的官方技能注册表。		 6,940

Want to add a skill?
想添加一项技能吗？

This list only includes skills that are already published in the github.com/openclaw/skills repository. We do not accept links to personal repos, gists, or any other external source. If your skill isn't in the OpenClaw skills repo yet, publish it there first.
此列表仅包含已发布在 github.com/openclaw/skills 代码库中的技能。我们不接受指向个人代码库、gist 或任何其他外部来源的链接。如果您的技能尚未添加到 OpenClaw 技能代码库，请先将其发布到那里。

Include both the ClawHub link (e.g. https://clawhub.ai/steipete/slack) and the GitHub link (e.g. https://github.com/openclaw/skills/tree/main/skills/steipete/slack) in your PR description. See CONTRIBUTING.md for details.
请在您的 PR 描述中包含 ClawHub 链接（例如 https://clawhub.ai/steipete/slack ）和 GitHub 链接（例如 https://github.com/openclaw/skills/tree/main/skills/steipete/slack ）。详情请参阅 CONTRIBUTING.md 文件。

Security Notice  安全通知

Skills in this list are curated, not audited. They may be updated, modified, or replaced by their original maintainers at any time after being added here.
此列表中的技能由我们整理，未经审核 。添加后，其原维护者可能随时对其进行更新、修改或替换。

Before installing or using any Agent Skill, review potential security risks and validate the source yourself. OpenClaw has a VirusTotal partnership that provides security scanning for skills, visit a skill's page on ClawHub and check the VirusTotal report to see if it's flagged as risky.
在安装或使用任何代理技能之前，请务必评估潜在的安全风险并自行验证其来源。OpenClaw 与 VirusTotal 建立了合作关系，VirusTotal 会为技能提供安全扫描服务。您可以访问 ClawHub 上的技能页面，查看 VirusTotal 报告，确认该技能是否被标记为存在风险。

Recommended tools:  推荐工具：

  • Snyk Skill Security Scanner
    Snyk Skill 安全扫描器
  • Agent Trust Hub  代理信任中心

Agent skills can include prompt injections, tool poisoning, hidden malware payloads, or unsafe data handling patterns. Always review the source code before installing and use skills at your own discretion.
代理程序可能具备的技能包括提示注入、工具投毒、隐藏恶意软件载荷或不安全的数据处理模式。安装前务必查看源代码，并自行斟酌使用这些技能。

If you believe a skill in this list should be flagged or has a security concern, please open an issue so we can review it.
如果您认为此列表中的某项技能应该被标记或存在安全隐患，请提交问题以便我们进行审查。
